title: Test eligible hopsets and basis prerequisites
description:
Scope: hopset and operating-basis prerequisite cases in the independently specified admission supplement under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/. Consume authority.05's bandwidth, spacing, available-channel and use/synchronization requirements. Cover empty/insufficient sets, 49/50 unique eligible frequencies under the declared narrow-FHSS basis, duplicates, sparse masks and disabled fixed-CH0/home combinations. Use independent set/resource counts and explicit use traces where supported. Do not invent a hopping algorithm, fairness threshold, measurement result or new regulatory interpretation.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use the authority handoff as the interpretation oracle and vectors.03 for exact index/mask arithmetic. Actual RF hopping qualification remains outside software scenario definition.
acceptance_criteria: Source-backed cases distinguish total entries from unique eligible physical frequencies and reject missing bandwidth/spacing/use/synchronization prerequisites. A 128-entry tuning list, individual packet-duration check or fixed receiver-home choice cannot establish FHSS permission. Any tested pseudorandom/equal-average behavior uses the declared contract and actual emitted sequence, not an invented statistical constant. Unsupported or unknown prerequisite evidence remains fail-closed, with no automatic alternative-basis fallback.
